title: Clothes Moth Pheromone Traps (6 Pack) – Sticky Monitoring Traps for Wardrobe, Closet & Drawers – Indoor Traps for Clothes & Carpet Moths – Non Toxic, Odourless
bullet_points: DETECT MOTH ACTIVITY BEFORE DAMAGE OCCURS Clothes moth pheromone traps help monitor moth activity and identify early signs of infestation in wardrobes, closets and drawers. Attracts male moths so you can take action before damage to clothes, carpets and fabrics appears.

HELPS MONITOR & PROTECT CLOTHES, CARPETS & FABRICS A simple way to monitor moth activity and reduce the risk of damage to clothing, wool, carpets and stored textiles. Suitable for use in wardrobes, drawers and storage spaces.

description: Clothes moths can quietly damage clothing, carpets and natural fabrics before you even notice them. InsectiX Clothes Moth Traps are designed to help detect and monitor clothes moth activity early, protecting your garments and textiles before visible damage occurs. Using a specialised pheromone lure, these pheromone moth traps attract male clothes moths and capture them on a discreet sticky surface. This allows you to quickly identify moth presence and monitor activity levels in wardrobes, drawers, cupboards and closets. Designed for use as wardrobe moth traps, cupboard moth traps and indoor moth traps, they are ideal for protecting clothing, wool garments, carpets and stored fabrics where moth activity may develop. These non toxic moth traps are odourless and free from biocidal chemicals, making them safe to use around clothes, people and pets when used as intended. No sprays, no fumes, no contamination of fabrics. Each moth monitoring trap provides long-lasting performance for up to 90 days, helping you track clothes moth activity over time and detect early signs of potential infestations. Simple to use and discreet in design, InsectiX clothes moth traps offer a reliable solution for ongoing moth monitoring in wardrobes, closets, drawers and textile storage spaces.
